item.title: Budget amendment bill tabled in Parliament amid opposition protest
item.description: The government tabled a budget amendment bill in the House of Representatives on Wednesday, while opposition parties objected to the process.

item.title: NEPSE index climbs 40 points as turnover crosses Rs 10 billion
item.description: The stock market rallied for a third straight day, led by banking and hydropower shares as interest rates eased.

item.title: Nepal beat hosts by six wickets in tri-nation cricket series opener
item.description: A captain’s half-century guided Nepal to a comfortable chase in the first match of the tri-nation series.

item.title: Telecom regulator directs operators to cut mobile internet prices
item.description: The Nepal Telecommunications Authority has asked service providers to lower data tariffs before the festive season.

item.title: Long-distance bus tickets for Dashain go on sale
item.description: Transport operators have opened advance booking for travellers heading home for the festival.
